# Codex configuration
# Written by hand; keep the comments.

model = "user-pick"
model_reasoning_effort = "high"
approval_policy = "on-request"
sandbox_mode = "workspace-write"
model_provider = "astra"

# My preferred shell environment
[shell_environment_policy]
inherit = "core"
ignore = ["AWS_*", "AZURE_*"]

[projects."/Users/token/code/astra"]
trust_level = "trusted"

[sandbox_workspace_write]
network_access = true

# Third-party providers live here
[model_providers.openrouter]
name = "OpenRouter"
base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
env_key = "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"
wire_api = "responses"

[profiles.fast]
model_provider = "openrouter"
model = "openai/gpt-5.1"

[model_providers.astra]
name = "Astra"
base_url = "https://astra.corp.com/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
experimental_bearer_token = "sk-astra-enterprise-key"
requires_openai_auth = false
